Upstream corresponding-source location for the bundled Git for Windows / MinGit
===============================================================================

This file records the canonical upstream location of the corresponding source
code for the exact pinned version of Git for Windows that Lares bundles as
MinGit. It is provided for convenience only; the binding obligation is the
three-year written offer in SOURCE-OFFER.txt, not this URL.

Replace <PINNED-VERSION> with the pinned git-for-windows release tag recorded in
mingit-manifest.json (for example, a tag of the form vX.Y.Z.windows.N).

Source release page (tag + release notes + source archives):

    https://github.com/git-for-windows/git/releases/tag/<PINNED-VERSION>

Full source tree at the pinned tag:

    https://github.com/git-for-windows/git/tree/<PINNED-VERSION>

Source archive (tarball) at the pinned tag:

    https://github.com/git-for-windows/git/archive/refs/tags/<PINNED-VERSION>.tar.gz

Git for Windows is itself a downstream of upstream Git (https://git-scm.com);
the git-for-windows/git repository above is the corresponding source for the
Windows binaries Lares bundles.
